query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing unexpected temperature profile variations in our atmospheric distillation unit. Can you help diagnose potential root causes?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and identify the underlying factors contributing to abnormal temperature distributions in an atmospheric distillation column.

communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative problem decomposition and integrated analysis
